context: Sho and Hina draw flowers in the garden.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Sho, let's draw some flowers together!
lines.style: High, eager opening. Voice rises with genuine excitement. Soft child-bright tone, unselfconscious warmth. Natural rhythm of an 8-year-old proposing something she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine agreement. Quiet warmth in the voice. Speaks gently without hesitation. The natural ease of a 6-year-old saying what he actually feels.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, open-ended question. Seeks his input without commanding. Warm enthusiasm that includes rather than leads. Natural child-cadence with a soft rising inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, definite choice. Speaks it like a quiet decision made. No doubt in his voice, just calm certainty. 6-year-old clarity without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Drawing together is so much fun!
lines.style: Warm, open-hearted closing. Soft delight in her voice. The word 'together' carries genuine affection. Child-bright but tender, genuine joy at including him.
